claim: Sept-Oct 2024 Kathmandu floods: DHM issued an accurate alert four days ahead but communication was not effective to the last mile; ~250 deaths.
quoted_support: in-spite of a clear and categorical alert, four days in advance from the Department of Hydrology and Metrology (DHM) Nepal... the communication of alert was not very effective and result oriented.
stance_target: Warning dissemination gaps are a key improvement area
